### [SCENE 3: THE LAL SAREE & THE PEEPAL TREE]
**NARRATOR:**  
Is border ke kareeb, ek kahani baar-baar sunayi deti hai. Ek aisi kahani jo darr se zyada... ek ajeeb si udaasi ko darshati hai.

(beat)

"Lal Saree." 

Log ise sirf ek afwah nahi maante. Wo ek haqiqat hai jo is zameen ka hissa ban chuki hai. Jab raat ke 1:00 baje hote hain, aur Sitamarhi ki khamoshi apne peak par hoti hai... tab log dekhte hain. 

(slow)

(pause)
Wo wahan baithi rehti hai... bina hile, bina bole. Bas door tak dekhti rehti hai. Log kehte hain ki agar aap uske kareeb se guzrein, toh aapko ek thandi hawa ka jhonka mehsoos hoga... jaise koi aapke kaan ke paas ruka ho.

---

### [SCENE 4: THE SECOND SANKAT - THE VEIL OF MIST]
**NARRATOR:**  
Jaise-jaise aap aage badhte hain, raasta aur bhi sunsaan hota jata hai. Ye doosra "Sankat" point hai. Yahan ki dhool aur mitti mein ek bhari-pan aa jata hai. 

(slow)
Yahan ka mausam aksar daldal jaisa mehsoos hota hai—bhari, chipchipa aur thanda. Raat ke 2 baje ke aas-paas, yahan ki dhund (mist) itni gehri ho jati hai ki aapko apne haath bhi dikhna band ho jate hain. 

(beat)
Is waqt, aapki sunne ki shakti badh jati hai. Aapko door kahin kisi purane darwaze ke khulne ki awaaz aayegi... ya shayad kisi purani ghanti ki goonj. Yeh koi cinematic jump-scare nahi hai. Ye sirf ek ehsaas hai—ki aap is waqt akele nahi hain. 

(pause)
Is border par, kuch cheezein "stuck" reh jati hain. Waqt wahin ruk jata hai. Aur jab aap is daldali dhund se guzarte hain, toh aisa lagta hai jaise aap ek dusri duniya ki dehleez paar kar rahe hain.

---

### [SCENE 5: THE THIRD SANKAT - THE FINAL THRESHOLD]
**NARRATOR:**  
Ab hum pahunchte hain teesre aur sabse gehre "Sankat" par. Ye wo jagah hai jahan Saran aur Sitamarhi ki hadd bilkul dhundhla jati hai. 

(slow)
Yahan ke pedon ka ghera itna ghana hai ki suraj ki roshni bhi din mein mushkil se pahunchti hai. Raat ko, ye ek jail ki tarah lagta hai. Yeh wo jagah hai jahan log rukne se darrte hain. 

(beat)
Yahan mitti ka rang thoda alag hai—gehra aur purana. Yahan ke pathar bhi jaise koi dard chupa rakhte hain. Jab aap yahan se guzarte hain, toh aapko mehsoos hoga ki hawa ruk gayi hai. Ek dum sannata. 

(pause)
Jaise koi saans rok kar baitha ho. 

Is point par, agar aap dhyaan se sunein... to aapko lag sakta hai ki mitti ke neeche kuch harkat ho rahi hai. Jaise purani yaadein zameen se bahar nikalne ki koshish kar rahi hon. Yeh wo jagah hai jahan "Lal Saree" wali aurat ka aks sabse zyada gehra hota hai. 

---

### [SCENE 6: THE WATCHING EYES]
**NARRATOR:**  
Log puchte hain, "Kya wahan sach mein koi hai?" 

(slow)
Sach ye hai ki wahan 'kuch' zaroor hai. Ek urja (energy), jo sadiyon se isi mitti mein basi hui hai. Ye wo log hain jo rasta bhatak gaye, ya shayad unhone khud apna raasta chuna aur woh kabhi peeche nahi mud sake. 

(beat)
Jab aap 3 baje ki taraf badhte hain, jab raat ka sabse gehra hissa hota hai... tab ye jagah ek ajeese dukh se bhari ho jati hai jo sirf khamoshi hi samajh sakti hai. 

(pause)
Aapko lag sakta hai ki koi aapko dekh raha hai. Peepal ke patton ke peeche, ya purani imaraton ke toote hue darwazon ke peeche. Wo aapko nuksan nahi pahunchana chahte... wo sirf wahan hain. Kyunki woh kabhi jaa nahi paaye.

### [SCENE 7: THE RETURN TO REALITY]
**NARRATOR:**  
Jaise hi subah ki pehli kiran ka waqt kareeb aata hai, aur 3 baje ka sannata thoda tootne lagta hai... ye sab dhundhla padne lagta hai. 

(slow)
Lekin wo mitti nahi badalti. Wo peepal ke ped ab bhi wahin khade hain. Aur woh "Lal Saree" wali aurat? Wo aaj bhi usi tark (logic) ke bahar, us purane sannate ka hissa hai. 

(pause)
Saran aur Sitamarhi ka ye crossroads... yeh sirf ek rasta nahi hai. Yeh ek yaadgaah hai. Ek aisa kone mein chhupa sach jo har kisi ko nazar nahi aata, par jo wahan maujood hai. 

(beat)
Agar aap kabhi us raaste se guzrein, to yaad rakhiyega... kuch jagahon ka apna ek waqt hota hai. Aur agar aap unka waqt pakad len, toh wo jagah aapko kabhi bhulne nahi degi.
